tapChoice: Katso, onko kuvassa yksi vai monta. Napauta sanaa, joka sopii kuvaan.
tapChoiceWord: Lue sana. Kertooko se yhdestä vai monesta? Napauta yksi tai monta.
notes: The Finnish sort page does NOT head its bins yksikkö/monikko: data/b2/labels.js singularPlural.fi = {one: yksi, many: monta}, and the printed titles all say Yksi vai monta, so on screen the sort buttons read yksi / monta. tapChoiceWord names exactly those two button labels. If the buttons are ever changed to yksikkö/monikko, this string must change with them.

tapChoice: on the picture pages the buttons show the word forms themselves (e.g. omena / omenat), so the string asks the child to look at how many there are and tap the fitting word, echoing printed K-288 (sana, joka sopii kuvaan: yksi vai monta). Printed Laske (count) replaced by Katso: one versus three pictures needs no counting and the number is not the task.
Napauta is the standard Finnish tap verb in children's apps.
English source: the phrase 'goes in front of it' is article-specific and cannot be carried to Finnish; that is expected, not a defect.
